definitions.rmse: Time-weighted consumed velocity error per axis, m/s; frozen main window
definitions.J: Arithmetic mean of three per-axis RMSEs; run metrics averaged descriptively
definitions.tv: Actual-update correction / total acceleration / normalized thrust kept separate; not energy
definitions.tv_units: Acceleration TV m/s^2; TV/T m/s^3. Normalized thrust TV dimensionless; TV/T 1/s
definitions.missing: Unknown stays null; failed/missing not filled with zero; no old runs fill new gates
definitions.takeoffs: Command, airborne-task and landed-disarmed events separate; command is not proof of lift-off

limitations: Per-algorithm planned n=3 development samples, not significance or universal superiority
Only observed attempts serialized; only accepted independently bound metrics enter means
Partial accepted means may have selection bias; different gates not pooled
Retained A retains its original source and checker, not regraded by revision05
Raw hashes and existing replay proof checked; no ULog decoding, flight, or new gate receipt
Summary has no execution authority; host cost is not board CPU and TV is not energy

qualification.scope: Historical source-bound offline evidence; no comparison to current HEAD or current binary

PID.aggregation: Descriptive arithmetic mean of accepted, individually verified run metrics only
